scope: Exact scalar transformed linear stage problem; lifts by unitary diagonalization to normal Jacobians with nonpositive real spectrum and norm 2. Floating solve/recurrence rounding and nonlinear drift require separate bounds.

conditional_cost_example.scope: Conditional equal initial preconditioned residual R=1 and contraction q=1/2 in the proved scalar/normal-NSD regime; iteration-cost guarantee, not wall time.

cases.method: Exact rational power-to-Bernstein conversion, convex-hull upper bounds, dyadic de Casteljau subdivision. Lower bound uses p_8 identically 1.
